issues.message: Level1 visible runway must prevent the reproduced natural route from falling while preserving the authored opening teaching branch and existing support fixtures.
acceptance: level1-runway-main is collidable in the authored course
runway sharp tip/edge contacts at player.x>=350 do not anchor; body/handle contacts still produce controlled bounce/recovery
opening teaching event order remains visible and does not publish a duplicate early runway bounce
the seed31 normal tap replay reaches at least 12 seconds and x>2000 without failure
the existing complete test suite, lint and typecheck pass

instructions: 这是第4/5次修复；保留 attempt-1 至 attempt-3 历史证据。
先在当前源码写针对 sharp runway contact、body bounce、opening event 和 replay 的 RED 测试，再修改最小因果文件。
允许修改范围仅为 Level1 数据、Level1 support collision branch 和其回归测试；不得改其他关卡、共享工厂、发布配置或无关渲染。
使用命名常量表达 runway id、sharp suppression threshold 和 early event suppression window，禁止散落 magic numbers。
运行完整 pnpm test、pnpm lint、pnpm typecheck，最多一次 pnpm build；完成后写严格 FixResultSchema。
不要把自然 QA 或状态注入测试伪装成通过；独立 QA 仍由后续阶段执行。
